decisions.decision: Fixed deletedAt RxDB schema omission (Codex PR review finding, comment 3548001004)
decisions.rationale: 01-01 Task 3 excluded deletedAt from the v0 schema entirely while Task 4 writes deletedAt: null via put() — RxDB defaults additionalProperties:false, so the first write would have been rejected. Declared deletedAt as an optional (non-required) v0 property and added explicit null<->omitted-key mapping to put()/get() in 01-01 instead of deferring to 01-02 (which never actually implemented it). Also dropped db.ts from 01-02's files_modified since neither of its tasks actually edits it.
